blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Eight people, including six students, were injured when a tricycle and a motorcycle collided along the Provincial Road at Barangay Ginablan in Romblon town at around 4:15 p.m. on Thursday, police said. The crash involved a red Yamaha STX 155 tricycle driven by a 61-year-old man and carrying six students—five girls aged 12 to 17 and a 13-year-old boy, the Philippine Information Agency (PIA) in Romblon reported, citing the initial investigation of the Romblon Municipal Police Station (MPS).
